purpose: Exploratory cross-era coverage/stability test of the proposed Historical Reachability transition lens. This does not discover new historical facts and does not validate universal laws.

classes.T1_POTENTIATE: Acquire a prerequisite that changes whether a later transition/path can occur.
classes.T2_COMPLEMENT: Compose mechanism with materials, skills, infrastructure, institutions or other complements into a usable system.
classes.T3_INSTRUMENT: Expand observation/discrimination capability so new questions or rival-world distinctions become reachable.
classes.T4_REPRESENT_STANDARDIZE: Create/adopt a representation, interface, notation, protocol or standard that adds coordination/composition edges.
classes.T5_RECONFIGURE_RECOMBINE: Reuse/recombine a capability, artifact or production mechanism under a materially different target.
classes.T6_EXTERNALIZE_ACCESS: Reach capability through an external expert/vendor/institution/lab/market/other carrier rather than local reproduction.
classes.T7_VALIDATE_REALIZE_STAGE: Cross a realization stage such as proof, repeatability, production, deployment, diffusion or durable service.
classes.T8_CONSTRAIN_PRUNE: Close/forbid a route or action to preserve validity, safety, completion or option structure.
classes.T9_SCALE_MOVE_BOUNDARY: Scaling changes the governing bottleneck, objective, externality, logistics, authority or relevant problem boundary.
classes.T10_LOSS_LOCKIN_DECAY: Capability/search space contracts through loss, lock-in, decay, path dependence or institutional/technical closure.
classes.OTHER: Source-grounded reachability-changing structure is material but not adequately represented above.
classes.NONE: The trajectory does not provide enough evidence of a material reachability/search-basis transition for this lens.

codingRules: Select 1 to 3 classes only when source-native facts materially support them; NONE is allowed.
Do not map every complement or institution mention automatically; require a reachability/search/realization consequence.
Do not infer current capability or universal causation from historical outcome.
Distinguish transition type from final success/failure standing.
OTHER is positive evidence against current lens coverage and must not be forced into the nearest class.
No original HD S/R/H labels are visible to the coder.
analysis: class frequency by epoch/domain is descriptive only
replicate exact-set and Jaccard agreement measure coding stability
reasons are inspected for label stuffing and source leakage
no promotion follows from recurrence alone
